name: ShareX
what_it_is: A free and open source screenshot tool for Windows that also records screen video and GIFs and automates tasks after capture.
platforms: Windows (the page names Windows only; a macOS and Linux artifacts link appears without details)
pricing: Completely free, with no advertisements; the footer says 'Free forever. Open source. No account required.' A Donate page is linked.
notable: Page states over 34 million downloads worldwide
Distributed via Setup, Portable, Microsoft Store and Steam

facts.fact: ShareX is a free and open source screenshot tool for Windows, according to the vendor home page.
The vendor page says the software is completely free with no advertisements, and free forever, open source and requires no account.
The vendor page lists capture modes including fullscreen, active window, region, scrolling capture and screen recording.
The vendor page carries the copyright line 'Copyright © 2007-2026 ShareX Team' and says it has over 18 years of active development.
The vendor page states 29 supported interface languages.

name: Fraps
what_it_is: A Windows utility that shows frame rate, takes screenshots and records video in games that use DirectX or OpenGL.
pricing: A free download to try the software; the paid 'unrestricted full version' requires registration. The download page gives no full-version price.
notable: Latest release listed on the download page is Fraps 3.5.99, dated 26 February 2013
The vendor page does not say the product is discontinued; the writer should treat the 2013 release date as a freshness caveat

facts.fact: Fraps is a universal Windows application for showing frame rates, taking screenshots and recording video in games that use DirectX or OpenGL.
The vendor page says 'fraps' and 'beepa' are registered trademarks of Beepa Pty Ltd.
The vendor page offers a free download and describes a paid unrestricted full version that requires registration.
The download page gives the latest release as Fraps 3.5.99, dated February 26th, 2013.
The vendor page lists real-time video capture at up to 7680x4800 resolution and 1 to 120 fps.

name: Lumia Stream
what_it_is: An all-in-one streaming tool that combines multistream chat, alerts, OBS overlays, a loyalty system and viewer-controlled lights and devices in one app.
platforms: Windows, Mac and Linux; chat from Twitch, TikTok, YouTube, Discord, Kick and Facebook; overlays for Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok and Facebook
pricing: Free to download; Premium is listed at $5.99 per month, $32.99 every 6 months, or $59.99 per year (Most Popular), with automatic renewal. A lifetime option is listed without a price.
notable: Home page lists integrations with OBS, Streamlabs, StreamElements, Streamerbot, Stream Deck and Touch Portal

facts.fact: Lumia Stream describes itself as an all-in-one streaming tool with multistreaming, light control, loyalty rewards and overlays in one app.
The pricing page lists a free plan with a 'Download for free' call to action.
The pricing page lists Premium at $5.99 per month, $32.99 every 6 months, or $59.99 per year, and says subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled.
The home page lists Windows, Mac and Linux among the operating systems it supports.
The home page lists a Stream Deck plugin and a Touch Portal plugin among its companion services.

name: Streamloots
what_it_is: A monetization platform for streamers with viewer-triggered interactive cards, subscriptions, auctions, a marathon timer and tips.
platforms: Logins via Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Facebook, Google and Trovo; the page says it works on all major streaming platforms
pricing: The only pricing wording is 'Join Now for Free'. Creators keep 80% of subscription revenue (90% for Partners); Partners keep 90% of every tip. No plan tiers or fees are listed.
notable: Home page cites 100,000+ creators and 150+ collections
Payouts run twice a month, on the 1st and 15th

facts.fact: Streamloots is a monetization platform for streamers that offers interactive cards, subscriptions, auctions, a marathon timer and tips.
The vendor page says creators keep 80% of subscription revenue, rising to 90% for Partners, and Partners keep 90% of every tip.
The vendor page's only pricing call to action is 'Join Now for Free' and it lists no plan tiers or fees.
The vendor page says payouts run twice a month, on the 1st and 15th.
The footer of the vendor page reads '© 2024 Streamloots. All Rights Reserved.' and gives hi@streamloots.com as the contact address.

name: Muxy
what_it_is: A company that builds interactive Twitch extensions and live stream experiences, with an SDK and tools for audience interaction.
platforms: Twitch (core platform); the page also shows Discord, TikTok and YouTube under reach
pricing: Not listed. The only call to action is 'Build Your Extension', which links to a contact page. The contact page shows no pricing either.
notable: Page says the company has been creating Twitch extensions and live stream technology since 2014
Page shows 2K, WB Games, Psyonix, THQ Nordic, The Pokémon Company International, Twitch, Amazon, SEGA, Bethesda and Blizzard Entertainment as clients
Page claims a backend supporting over 2 million concurrent users

facts.fact: Muxy describes itself as a company that builds interactive live stream experiences, with Twitch extensions as its core.
The vendor page says the company has been creating Twitch extensions and live stream technology since 2014.
Pricing is not published; the vendor page's only call to action is 'Build Your Extension', which links to a contact page.
The vendor page lists campaign analytics (views, interaction rates and channel attribution) and an SDK among its tools.
The vendor page carries the footer line 'Muxy © 2026' with links to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
